events.category: Living master / Chick Corea tribute / bass-piano-string collaboration
events.factual_description: Strathmore presents Stanley Clarke and Hiromi featuring PUBLIQuartet on Thursday, April 8, 2027 at 8:00 PM at The Music Center at Strathmore. The program is billed as A Celebration of the Music of Chick Corea and Beyond and combines Corea compositions with new works inspired by his legacy. Strathmore identifies Clarke as Corea's longtime collaborator in Return to Forever and notes that Hiromi's connection with Corea began when he invited her to perform with him in Tokyo at age 17. PUBLIQuartet adds an improvisation-minded string-quartet layer. Strathmore lists tickets at $28-$98.

en.why_it_matters: This is not a generic tribute to Chick Corea. Clarke helped build Return to Forever with him, while Hiromi's own relationship with Corea began when he brought her onstage in Tokyo as a teenager; putting those two voices together with PUBLIQuartet turns shared history into a live problem of texture, improvisation and memory. Bass, piano and an improvisation-minded string quartet should let Corea's music move between fusion drive, chamber detail and open conversation rather than repertory reenactment.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for this one. It is local enough to build the North Bethesda evening around the 8:00 PM performance, with no corridor travel required; the touring nature of the project means the reason to go is the unusually strong configuration and local opportunity, not artificial scarcity.

es.why_it_matters: No es un homenaje genérico a Chick Corea. Clarke construyó con él buena parte del lenguaje de Return to Forever, mientras la relación de Hiromi con Corea comenzó cuando la invitó a tocar con él en Tokio siendo todavía adolescente; reunir esas dos voces con PUBLIQuartet convierte una historia compartida en un problema en vivo de textura, improvisación y memoria. Bajo, piano y un cuarteto de cuerdas con vocación improvisatoria pueden mover la música de Corea entre el empuje de la fusión, el detalle de cámara y la conversación abierta, en vez de limitarse a reconstruir repertorio.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente. Es suficientemente local para armar la noche en North Bethesda alrededor de la función de las 8:00 PM, sin tratarla como viaje por el corredor; como el proyecto está de gira, la razón para ir es la configuración excepcional y la oportunidad local, no una escasez artificial.
